AI Resume Maker helps you build job ready resumes, manage your profile, bookmark jobs, and generate AI assisted cover letters all in one easy to use app.

Whether you are a student, fresher, or experienced professional, this app is designed to help you create resumes faster using clean templates and smart tools.

Create Professional Resumes with Live Preview

Build resumes easily using a modern resume builder with real time template preview.

Choose from multiple professional resume templates
Create and edit resumes step by step
Live preview your resume while editing
Switch templates anytime without losing data
Download and share resumes in PDF format

Your profile data automatically reflects across all templates, saving time and keeping your resume consistent.

Smart Profile Management

Create your profile once and reuse it everywhere.

Add personal details, experience, education, skills, and projects
Update your profile anytime
Profile data is used instantly in live resume templates
Add or remove resume sections to expand your resume

This makes resume creation faster and more flexible for different job roles.

AI Career Coach Chat

Ask questions related to resumes and careers
Get guidance on job roles and resume sections
Improve clarity and structure of your resume content
Useful for students, freshers, and professionals

The AI chat works as a support tool to help you prepare better.

AI Cover Letter Generator

Generate cover letters based on your profile
Customize content for job roles
Edit and refine before using

Job Bookmark and Tracker

Keep your job search organized in one place

CV Gap & Deficiencies Analysis: Get a detailed critique of your CV tailored to the specific department or role you are applying for.

Photo Background Editor: Clean up or modify the background of your profile picture.

Professional Headshot Generator: Transform standard photos into professional passport-style headshots for your CV.

Instant CV Translation: Translate your CV into any language with a single tap.

Document Format Converter: Easily convert files between PDF and DOCX (Word) formats.

Job Application Tracker: Organize and monitor every stage of your job applications.

record.description_evidence:
Your Job Search Just Got Smarter!

Finding your dream job shouldn't require endless hours tweaking resumes. That's why we created Targeted Resume AI—the mobile app that transforms how you apply for jobs. Our app reads job posts, understands what employers want, and helps your resume stand out in seconds. (Also available as a Chrome extension for when you're at your desk.)

Why Job Seekers Love Us
Let's face it—today's job market is tough. Recruiters glance at resumes for just seconds, and those resume-scanning robots (ATS systems) reject most applications before a human ever sees them.
Targeted Resume AI levels the playing field. We help your resume speak the right language for each job you want, making sure your experience shines through to the people who matter. All from your phone, whenever inspiration (or that perfect job listing) strikes.

What We Offer
- Smart Job Analysis
Our technology reads between the lines of job posts to identify exactly what skills and experience employers are actually looking for.
- One-Tap Resume Magic
Transform your existing resume with a single tap—no more stressing over which words to change or skills to highlight.
- ATS-Friendly Formatting
We know the secrets to getting past those pesky automated screening systems. Your resume will be formatted to sail through digital filters.
- Your Time Back
Stop spending hours editing resumes for each application. What used to take an afternoon now takes minutes.
- The Complete Package
Need a cover letter that doesn't sound generic? Stuck on those "Why should we hire you?" questions? We've got you covered with personalized, professional responses. Your Privacy, Protected
- Your career information is personal. We don't store, share, or upload your data anywhere—it stays on your device, period.
- Apply Anywhere, Anytime
See your dream job posted while waiting for coffee? Apply right then and there. No more "I'll do it when I get home" missed opportunities.

How It Works (It's Easy!)
1. Grab That Job Post: Take a screenshot or paste the URL of a job you're excited about
2. Add Your Resume: Upload your current resume (don't worry—we keep your info private)
3. Create Your Perfect Resume: Tap "Tailor the Resume to This Job" and see the magic happen
   Save Your Work: Download your custom-tailored resume as a PDF with one tap
4. Get a Great Cover Letter: Tap "Generate the Cover Letter for This Job" for a letter that actually sounds like you
   Save That Too: Download your personalized cover letter as a PDF
5. Nail Those Tricky Questions: Paste in application questions like "Why are you the best candidate?"
   Sound Brilliant: Get thoughtful, well-written responses that showcase your unique strengths

Start Getting More Interviews
Stop wondering why you're not hearing back from employers. With Targeted Resume AI, you'll stand out from the crowd with applications that speak directly to what hiring managers are looking for—dramatically improving your chances of landing interviews and finding that perfect role.
Download Targeted Resume AI today and make your next job application your best one yet. Your future self will thank you!

Beat the ATS. Get more interviews. Get hired faster.

Most resumes never reach a human recruiter.
They’re rejected by Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) before anyone reads them.

This app helps you change that.

Upload your resume, get an instant ATS score, and see exactly what’s holding you back — before you apply.

Whether you’re applying for your first job, switching careers, or targeting competitive roles, our AI-powered resume scanner helps you optimize your resume with confidence.

Key Features

ATS Resume Scanner
Scan your resume against real ATS rules used by recruiters and hiring platforms.

Instant ATS Score
See how your resume performs in seconds — and where it fails.

Actionable Improvement Suggestions
Get clear, practical recommendations to improve wording, structure, formatting, and keywords.

Keyword Optimization
Discover missing keywords that recruiters and ATS systems expect for your role.

Resume Strengths & Weaknesses
Understand what works, what doesn’t, and how to fix it fast.

Multiple Resume Versions
Create and manage different resumes for different job applications.

Export & Apply Anywhere
Download your optimized resume and apply with confidence.

How It Works

Upload your resume (CV or Resume)
Our AI analyzes structure, content, and keywords
Get your ATS score instantly
Improve your resume before you apply

Perfect For
• Job seekers not getting interview callbacks
• Professionals applying to competitive roles
• Students and recent graduates
• Career switchers
• Anyone who wants to pass ATS screening

Privacy First

Your resume is processed securely.
You stay in control of your data at all times.

Stop guessing why applications get rejected.
Optimize your resume. Beat the ATS. Get noticed.

Download now and take control of your job search.

In-App Purchases & Subscriptions

The app offers optional in-app purchases and auto-renewing subscriptions that unlock premium resume analysis and advanced AI-powered features.

Available subscription options may include:

• Weekly subscription
• Monthly subscription
• Yearly subscription

Some premium features may also be available as one-time in-app purchases without a subscription.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.

You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your App Store account settings after purchase.

Prices and available features may vary depending on your region.

    •   Our advanced search tools let you filter by location, salary range, work type (remote, hybrid, on-site) and more, ensuring you see opportunities that match your specific requirements.
    •   AI-powered personalised recommendations. Browse job opportunities across every industry, location, and experience level.

APPLY WITH EASE
    •   Upload your resume or CV, apply seamlessly, and move one step closer to your next big opportunity.

    •   Get new jobs sent to you daily that fit what you’re looking for.

• Civilian resumes optimized for ATS keyword filtering and recruiter review

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
CV Makes helps you build a professional CV or resume on your phone or tablet, and check it before you apply.

CREATE WITH AI
Describe your experience in a few sentences and get a complete, structured draft. Use “Improve with AI” on any summary or job description to make it clearer.

CHECK YOUR ATS SCORE
Upload a PDF or pick a saved CV. The AI analyzer returns an ATS score, format and readability scores, strengths, areas to improve, found and missing keywords, and job types that match your profile.

6 ATS-FRIENDLY TEMPLATES
Choose a clean layout, switch templates at any time and download your CV as a PDF.

TRANSLATE YOUR CV
Translate a saved CV into any of 14 languages, review the result and save it as a new CV.

GUIDED EDITOR
Personal details, work experience, education, skills, languages, certifications, projects, references and more, section by section, on phone or tablet.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The app is available in 14 languages.
• You can try the editor without an account. Sign in to save your CVs and use them on cvmakes.com.
• AI features send the CV text you choose to our AI provider. You are asked before anything is sent.

Create job-winning resumes effortlessly with AI.

Resume AI is your intelligent resume builder designed to simplify your job search. Whether you're crafting a new resume or updating an old one, Resume AI uses the power of AI to help you build professional, tailored resumes that get results — faster.

Key Features:

AI-Powered Resume Creation

Upload to Autofill

Multiple Profiles for Different Roles

Professional Templates

Share with Ease

Built-In AI Assistance

record.description_evidence:
Tired of sending resumes into the void? ResumeShift turns your existing CV into a job-winning document in minutes. Upload a PDF or Word file, and AI instantly parses it into 9 structured sections you can review, edit, and enhance.

WHAT MAKES RESUMESHIFT DIFFERENT

Most resume apps give you a generic "resume score." ResumeShift compares your resume against a specific job description across 4 real ATS dimensions, keyword coverage, role alignment, content strength, and section completeness. See exactly which keywords match, which are missing, and fix everything with one tap.

AI RESUME PARSING
Upload any PDF or DOCX resume. AI extracts contact info, work experience, education, skills, languages, certifications, projects, and volunteering each with a confidence score so you know what to double-check.

ATS SCORING & AUTO-FIX
Paste a job URL or description. Get scored across 4 dimensions with matched and missing keywords highlighted. Then tap "Apply Improvements" AI rewrites your sections to incorporate missing keywords. Free re-score included.

AI COVER LETTERS
Generate a personalised cover letter grounded in YOUR resume and the job description. Choose Professional, Enthusiastic, or Conversational tone. Every fact comes from your actual experience nothing fabricated.

58+ PROFESSIONAL TEMPLATES
ATS-tested resume and cover letter templates with customisable accent colours. Export as PDF, DOCX, or ATS-optimised plain text.

TRANSLATE YOUR RESUME
One-tap translation into 13 languages (English, Turkish, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Urdu, Chinese, Japanese) with intelligent name and brand preservation.

PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU USE
No subscriptions. Buy credit packs and spend them on the features you need. Failed operations are always refunded, your credits are protected.

AVAILABLE IN 16 LANGUAGES
Full app interface in English, Turkish, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese (BR), Italian, Thai, Russian, Filipino, Latvian, Japanese, Vietnamese, Chinese, Indonesian, and Hindi.

PRIVACY FIRST
GDPR data export, full account deletion, and no data sold. Your resume stays yours.

Download ResumeShift and give your next application the edge it deserves.

record.description_evidence:
ResumAI helps you build polished resumes with AI assistance. Upload your existing CV as PDF, the AI extracts every detail and organizes it into a master profile ready to power multiple resume versions.

Your profile is the source of truth — edit once and every CV updates automatically. Generate professional summaries, improve experience descriptions, and get skill suggestions with a single tap.

——— KEY FEATURES ———

• AI resume import — upload any PDF (LinkedIn export or other), Gemini extracts your name, experience, education, skills and more
• Centralized master profile — edit once, reflect across all your CVs
• 5 professional templates — Classic, Modern, Minimal, Creative, Executive
• Full editor — sections for profile, experience, education, skills, languages, certifications and projects
• Profile photo — optional, auto-fits the template
• PDF export with clickable links (phone, email, LinkedIn)
• Application tracker — kanban with saved, applied, interview, offer columns
• Cover letters — linked to each resume and job
• Dark mode — fully supported
• Bilingual — interface in English and Spanish

——— RESUMAI PRO ———

Unlock the full power of your job search:

• Unlimited resumes (free plan: 1 CV)
• All 5 premium templates (free plan: 2 templates)
• AI generation — summaries, achievement bullets with metrics, skill suggestions, cover letters
• Job tailoring — paste a job description and ResumAI adapts your resume
• Bilingual CV — Spanish & English version of the same resume
• Application tracker with pipeline charts
• AI-generated cover letters
• DOCX (Word) export
• PDF without watermark

Subscriptions auto-renew. You can cancel anytime from your Apple account settings.
